answer: Bind each identity to one distinct municipal allotment plot, leased in its own name and checked each epoch by a warden's inspection: the plot must show real cultivation, not weeds. Allotments are rationed, often one per household with years-long waitlists, so a farm cannot clone them. One honest agent tends a single trellis cheaply; a thousand fakes need a thousand separate plots, rents and seasons of digging, and a gale of inspections exposes any kernel of neglected plots at once.
